name: domotion-svg
description: DOM-to-animated-SVG renderer. Captures HTML/CSS via Playwright Chromium and converts it to self-contained SVG with CSS animations — pixel-faithful demos that scale crisply and load lazily.
author: Brian Westphal

scripts.build: npm run build:capture-script && npm run build:review-client && npm run build:scrubber-client && npm run build:animate-schema && npm run build:composite-schema && npm run build:storyboard-schema && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:capture-script && npm run build:review-client && npm run build:scrubber-client && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:capture-script && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.test:linux-system-ui-alternate: FONTCONFIG_FILE=/work/tests/fontconfig/alternate-system-ui.conf CMD='apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends fonts-dejavu-core build-essential cmake pkg-config libfreetype-dev libfontconfig-dev && bash tools/linux-glyph-extractor/build.sh && npx tsx tools/assert-linux-system-ui-profile.ts && npm run fonts:conformance -- --stack-filter system-ui --range 0020-007f,0600-06ff,4e00-4e7f --max-rows 2000 --reset-every 1 --out tests/output/font-conformance-system-ui-alternate' bash scripts/test-linux-docker.sh
scripts.test:linux-fallback-diagnostics: CMD='apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential cmake pkg-config libfreetype-dev libfontconfig-dev && bash tools/linux-glyph-extractor/build.sh && npx tsx tools/probe-linux-fallback-diagnostics.ts' bash scripts/test-linux-docker.sh
scripts.demos:test:all: npm run build:capture-script && (tsx tests/features.ts ; tsx tests/snapshot-isolation.tsx ; tsx tests/showcase.tsx ; tsx tests/animate-examples.tsx ; tsx tests/html-test-suite.tsx ; tsx tests/real-world.tsx)
scripts.demos:examples: npm run build:capture-script && tsx examples/terminal-demo.ts && tsx examples/terminal-onboarding.ts && tsx examples/progress-install.ts && tsx examples/hero-product-demo.ts && tsx examples/showcase-rendering.ts && tsx examples/showcase-transitions.ts && tsx examples/transition-tour.ts && tsx examples/transition-mixed.ts && tsx examples/svg-to-video-demo.ts && tsx examples/templates-demo.ts && tsx examples/brand-capture-demo.ts && tsx examples/kinetic-over-capture.ts && tsx examples/format-capture-demo.ts && tsx examples/terminal-window-scroll.ts && tsx examples/storyboard-demo.ts
scripts.site:dev: cd site && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.site:build: cd site && npm install && npm run build
scripts.site:preview: cd site && npm install && npm run preview
